messages.text:
A few things broke in the game, and I'd like them all fixed:

1. The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0.
2. I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore.
3. I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate.
4. The game started beeping when I find a pair.

Keep the rest working, and please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed all four regressions: best scores now keep the lowest result and show `none` for unrecorded sizes; arrow keys move focus within the board and stop at its edges; reduced motion disables card transitions and the win pulse; and match audio has been removed.

Verification passed: typecheck, 138 unit tests, and all 75 browser tests.

Key changes: [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60), [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30), [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx:42), [motion styles](/work/src/game/board/card.css:41), and [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:78).
